title: So glad you guys are there too
content: Long time lurker first time poster. After reading this sub I have come to realise that whenever I interact with anyone in Mall world it is always someone I know in real life. I tend to mostly frequent the pools, the amusement park and the night market. Things occur with people I know however all the places are always crowded. I never take much notice of the other people, much like walking around a busy mall in real life. Now it occurs to me those people are probably you guys, going about your business. Just wanted to say hi, nice to see you all there and likewise yes there are people I do not know, and some I don't even think are entirely human. They seem to have roles like vendors, security, guides and whatnot but there are definitely other living *people* and the more I go there the more I believe it's all of us. Anyone else think this way?
